site_pre_checkout_guidance: If the cart already has a valid item, navigate directly to the checkout URL (e.g. https://www.nike.com/checkout) to skip the product flow.

Before evaluating cart state, wait 3 seconds for the page to finish loading; ensure the cart has exactly one valid item — remove unavailable items (sold out/out of stock) or extra items; if empty, add any available product.
Prefer products with high stock availability — avoid items marked 'Just a few left', 'Low stock', or 'Sold Out'. Choose a common size (M or 10) to reduce sold-out risk.
site_checkout_guidance: To trigger the autofill popup, focus the email or firstName field (do not use payment/card fields).
Nike may show a saved address summary with the form collapsed — click Edit on the existing address to expand it, do not add a new one.

test_cases.name: Nike_autofill_Guest
pre_checkout_instructions: You must be signed out — do not sign in at any point during this test.

test_cases.name: Nike_autofill_Signed_In
test_cases.preconditions: Edge must have exactly one fully valid saved address, plus 5 profiles each with one invalid field (name='1', zip='1', phone='1', invalid email format, city='1').
pre_checkout_instructions: You must be signed in before reaching checkout. Sign in using email 'happyautoec@outlook.com' and password 'Happy@1234'. Prefer use verification code sent to email over password entry when possible.
pre_checkout_guidance: Before clicking Continue on the email entry page, call email_mark_baseline first.
checkout_instructions: Verify that the autofill popup shows only the one valid profile and invalid profiles are filtered out.
